_comment: STARTER config. These rules are plausible defaults for a React/Vite + Supabase repo; replace them with the real layer boundaries discovered in the architecture audit. 'include'/'exclude' are globs (** * ? {a,b}); 'forbid' is a list of JS regex sources; 'name' is what shows up in the gate output AND in a waiver's 'rule' field, so keep names stable.

rules.name: Domain/service/lib code must not import UI or touch web globals
rules.message: Business/domain code is leaking a web/UI concern. Keep React/DOM at the boundary; pass plain data into the service so it stays testable and reusable.

rules.name: Components and pages must not access the database directly
rules.message: Data access inside a component. Route it through the hook/service that OWNS this data so there is one writer and one read path.

rules.name: Edge functions must not read secrets outside their config/boundary
rules.message: Environment/secret access scattered through a function body. Read config once at the boundary and pass values in — this is a starter rule; tune paths to the real structure.
